title: Berlin Mathematical School (BMS) PhD Program, 2027 admission
about: The Berlin Mathematical School accepts 2027 applications: Phase I (master's studies) for bachelor's graduates and Phase II (doctoral research) for master's graduates. First round closes 1 December 2026, with 10 Phase I places with scholarship; second round runs to 1 April 2027.
requirements: Phase I: bachelor's degree completed by summer 2027
Recommendation letters due one week after the application deadline
